Exhibition Coming November 2026

The Nue Black Aesthetic

Become a Member Book your ticket
6 November 2026 – 8 August 2027

Explore a major exhibition celebrating contemporary Black designers who are reshaping the design landscape, from fashion and furniture to architecture, product design and sculpture.

Tickets are on sale.

What to expect

What does it mean to be a Black designer working today?

Guest curated by author and journalist Charlene Prempeh, this major exhibition will showcase the work of some of the most innovative contemporary Black designers working today.

With over 100 objects on display displayed across six sections, the show will demonstrate that Black design is not a monolith, and that there is no single way to be a Black designer. By spotlighting diverse practices and voices, the exhibition invites visitors to rethink assumptions about what Black design looks like and who gets to shape design culture.

Many of the designers featured belong to diasporic communities, balancing shared experiences with the distinct traditions of their specific heritage. Their varied approaches to identity, culture and community reflect the myriad nuances of the Black experience.

The title of the show references the cultural movements of the ‘Black Aesthetic’ of the 1960s and the ‘New Black Aesthetic’ of the 1980s. But this exhibition proposes a ‘Nue’ era – one defined by nuance, where there is no single way to be a Black designer.

Ini Archibong
Tejumola Adenuga

When you visit, don't forget to share your favourite designs with @designmuseum using the hashtag #NueBlackAesthetic

Related events

Tuesday 10 November, 19:00 – 20:20

Talk - Nue Forms: Reimagining Material Culture

Join a conversation with The New Black Aesthetic exhibition guest curator Charlene Prempeh and designers Mac Collins and Giles Tettey Nartey to explore how memory, material culture, ritual, and diaspora shape contemporary design, chaired by co-curator Tiya Dahyabhai.

  • Find out more
Friday 13 November, 10:30 – 12:00

Curator Tour of The Nue Black Aesthetic

Enjoy a group tour of the highlights and behind the scenes details of The Nue Black Aesthetic, delivered by the exhibition Guest Curator Charlene Prempeh and Co-curator Tiya Dahyabhai.

  • Find out more
Monday 23 November, 19:00 – 21:00

Fashion Life Drawing with Feben

Join us for an evening life-drawing session in the museum’s iconic atrium, facilitated and styled by celebrated fashion designer Feben, and inspired by a curator-led tour introducing fashion pieces featured in The New Black Aesthetic exhibition.
